title: Toulmin argument builder
summary: This visual holds the data of the Toulmin argument builder. Its page is now the notebook play/toulmin/ of yujieteo/site: each argument of an essay is a chapter of text boxes for its claim, grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier and rebuttals, with a pilot-style checklist (six automatic lines and six confirm questions), prompts and the generated paragraph claim-first and grounds-first. raw.json holds the six parts with Toulmin's Harry example, the checklist, the prompts, the paragraph lead-ins, the limits and a template essay of three arguments on surgical safety checklists.
